POSTNATAL PROGRESS NOTE (SOAP) - 07/04/2067 Clinic: Blue Mountain Women's Health Seen by: Dr. Aalto Rooming by volunteer Tyler (HS vol., supervised)
Pt arrived super chill, "vibes were good", baby with grandma Lorna in the waiting room.
S: Now ~6 wks post cesarean (05/23/2067). Feels well. Incision healed, no fever. Bleeding stopped 2 weeks ago. Breastfeeding mostly. Mood "tired but happy"; sleeps in 2-3 hr chunks. Not yet sexually active, and asks about options. O: Vitals normal, wt not recorded (scale broken). Pfannenstiel scar well healed, uterus involuted, no tenderness. Depression screen done today negative. A: 1. Postpartum, doing well. 2. Contraception counselling. P: Reviewed options. She will think about it, return in one week to discuss. Continue iron. Prediabetes -- repeat A1c at her next wellness exam in the spring.
Ms. F. was reminded about the 4 week check she missed. Signed Dr. Aalto 07/04/2067. (Draft by Tyler: "The twenty-fourth of May was a big day for her.")
